evidence: decorative_mascot: Data is parked on the leading bar's right edge in every single frame (hook@0.3, seg0:end, seg1:mid, seg2:end) and merely slides down to the 20.8 bubble at seg3:start — arms twitch, but there is no setup->action->payoff tied to land area, health spending, or crop index.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start (t=43.26s) the crop-index bubbles are barely 12px dots stranded in a huge dark field with the bottom third of the frame completely empty; by seg3:end the bubbles have grown but the frame is still a static two-row scatter with the mascot idling on the 20.8 dot and no motion beyond the caption.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The bubble layout scales radius from the smallest value, so early-index years render as near-invisible dots and the scene reserves grid space it never fills; the mascot is anchored to the leading bubble rather than performing against the 20.8 -> 100.0 five-fold jump.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Fill the frame for seg3: scale bubbles so even 20.8 reads as a substantial disc and the 100.0 bubble dominates, tighten/expand the grid to use the empty lower third, and give Data a real bit against the growth (e.g. he strains to hold up the tiny 1972 bubble, then is lifted/overtaken as the 2020 bubble swells past him) so the five-fold rise is demonstrated, not just plotted.
